fullContent:
Rajata Loha Rasayana 
 Reference – Rasa Yoga Ratnakara 
 Introduction 
 Rajata Loha Rasayana is an ayurvedic formulation that is known to be prepared from the mixture of minerals. This is known to treat problems of heart and respiratory system. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Gandhaka – Purified suphur 
 Parada – Purified murcury 
 Rajata Bhasma – silver calx 
 Loha Bhasma – iron calx 
 
 Method of preparation 
 All the ingredients are mixed together and this loha is prepared 
 Dosage 
 10 grams in 40 doses with honey or Tulsi Patra Ras 
 Anupana: Tulasi Patra Swarasa, Sitopaladi Choorna, Honey. 
 Indications 
 
 Cardiac pain 
 Cough 
 Bronchitis 
 Asthma 
 
 Contraindications 
 Take medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
